daily_schedule.window: [UTC calendar day start, next UTC calendar day start)
daily_schedule.retry: explicit scheduledAt in the same UTC day reuses the same project-scoped identity
daily_schedule.catch_up: each missed UTC date is invoked explicitly and has a distinct identity

eligible_projects.suspended_installation: blocked before remote read and dispatch
eligible_projects.revoked_installation: authorization_revoked before remote read and dispatch
eligible_projects.missing_mapping: blocked before remote read and dispatch

facts.collection_digest: lowercase sha256 of githubObjectId + unit-separator + sourceVersion records sorted by githubObjectId and joined by record-separator
facts.repository_digest: lowercase sha256 of stable repository id, full name, default branch, visibility, private, fork, archived and disabled fields
facts.local_source: structured Phase 1 snapshot columns filtered by sourceUpdatedAt >= snapshotSince
facts.remote_source: typed Phase 4 read models plus existing authorized-repository metadata reader

decision_matrix.active_and_equal: no_difference; zero SyncRun, job and snapshot writes
decision_matrix.remote_read_failure: failed; zero sync request and dispatch
decision_matrix.manual_owner_active: accepted or coalesced through database request
decision_matrix.manual_non_owner: forbidden with zero mutation and dispatch
decision_matrix.same_identity_terminal_replay: duplicate; no new SyncRun or job

coalescing.lock: transaction-scoped PostgreSQL advisory lock keyed by projectId
coalescing.partial_and_failed: historical rows remain unchanged and do not block a new request
coalescing.dispatch_inbox: one project_sync_dispatch row per SyncRun with pending/dispatching/dispatched state, optimistic version and a 60-second lease
coalescing.crash_recovery: missing receipt is reclaimed after lease expiry with the same BackgroundJob id, correlation id and idempotency key
coalescing.webhook_concurrency: Webhook remains object-level; project SyncRun count is one and Phase 1 project+object unique keys prevent duplicate snapshot facts

lineage: trigger source and stable request identity
trusted project, selected repository, installation and GitHub repository
existing snapshot, cursor and freshness contracts

database_boundary.direct_table_access: none for anon, authenticated and service_role
database_boundary.manual_actor: verified server-side user id passed to RPC and checked against projects.user_id
database_boundary.client_claims: repository, installation status, owner and freshness are never trusted

boundaries.domain_application: no Next, Supabase, Inngest or scheduler SDK imports
boundaries.scheduler: injects explicit scheduledAt only; no deployed cron
boundaries.manual_route: parses request, resolves verified session and maps stable result only
boundaries.database: owns project mapping, ownership, installation gate and cross-process coalescing
boundaries.reader: reads and hashes typed minimal facts only

forbidden_scope: raw GitHub response, source, diff or credentials
